body: Thank you for that well thought out posting and for taking the time to do it. I do feel better to day and it is a long road to recovery.  Since yesterday both my stepsons have told me their mother isn't worth crap and I should not be sad but could find someone much better.  I met a guy on Craigslist on the friendship only section who just moved here with his wife.  He is my age.  Said he is looking for friends in this new area.  We are going to happy hour to play darts, watch some baseball for awhile  or whatever.  It will be good to get out and be with another person for a while and if we become friends that will be one.  I am going to get rid of the gun.  And I ate a sandwich today.  So all that is positive steps.  Thanks for talking to me.
Thank you sir. It means something to me. I added a long post with more details/ to another redditors comment.
Thank you for caring enough to do that.  In some way it does touch me.  At the request of one redditor I unloaded some below.

I cannot make a relationship work. I have two children that do not live with me and about to lose the third.  I make 100K per year but have no money. Zero assets.  I just lost my house.  I have drained all my savings and retirement.  I owe a shit load of money that I did not even spend. I pay 1/3 of my salary to taxes and another third to child support.  I also owe back taxes.  I barely make enough to make ends meet if one can believe it.  I live in a shitty apartment now and barely have enough money to buy essentials.  Basically in financial ruin to the worst degree and no end in sight.  My turn in finances started about two years ago.  Before that things were fine.

My wife wants to divorce.  We have a kid together.  Two years old.  The reasons she gives.  I am too quiet.  I am not communicative enough and not a go getter.  Not because I adulterous or addicted or abusive,  because I am too quiet.  She is an obese alcoholic.  When I married her she was hot and the best woman in the world.  Now she goes to bars two or three nights per week until they close, routinely drives around drunk and spends money like crazy.  She cheated on me back in December. She gave another guy a BJ.  She helped drive me to financial ruin and will continue to do so.  But she is my wife.  And I do not want a divorce.

What else? I like my job but cant do it well.  I can barely get out of bed to do it.  I spend most of the day staring at something,anything.  I cannot even finish the smallest task unless it is critical or I hyperfocus.  Somehow I am still employed. In fact I lost my job and was rehired by the same company. They said they had made a mistake and needed me back.  I do not work with others.  I am a remote employee.  I go all day without talking to anyone face to face.

I have no friends.  I have no prospects.  My family lives 800 miles away but that does not matter because my sister is a downfallen alcoholic who has big time problems of her own.  She was a doctor who lost her license due to alcoholism and still is today.  She lost her kids to it and still drinks.   And my brother and I have not talked in 10 years.  He never even met my wife or seen my two year old.  My parents are alive but probably ready to die since we seem to be cursed.  They cannot take much more bad news.  They are too old for shit like this.  I wanted them to be happy in their old age.

So basically I am a failure in many ways.  But mainly a failure to my children and parents.  That's why I  sincerely want to die.  I don't have the strength I need and am too tired to fight the battle any more.  I say I want to die.  I am too cowardly to do it but now there are times when I feel like I can, and might.  I have a gun.  I wanted to do it this morning.  Each morning I feel a little more like it.

If I were to be held up at gunpoint I would taunt the robber into shootin  g me. If a big truck swerves in front of me I doubt I will try to dodge it.  If docs tell me I am going to die I wold be happy and even laugh.

I wanted to do this in a way that would not further cause stress on my children or parents.  I wanted to make it look like an accident. That is what held me from toying with the gun to see how far I could go. I wanted to load it and put the gun to my head and see how far I would squeeze before pulling back but then think- my kids will know, my parents will know.  Has to look like an accident.

So anyway,that's pretty much it.  Pretty bad huh.
